The “team lead office” and “hub personal” folders hold the same files; they show one office with six desks, larger than either cell. 56 and 58 in those folders were taken at 15:23 between the IoT Lab and Smart Ideas photos (ground floor) and are not used. People in the photos are ignored.

Built as new objects. Chalkboards and the wall clock on the west wall (176), the lead desk with an executive chair by the window and two red visitor chairs, a navy two-seat sofa beside the door, two glass-door bookcases with binders and a drawer unit with a printer on the east wall, vertical blinds, glazed office front on the corridor side, the door leaf standing open into the room.

Dropped (real scale, no shrinking).

  • 3 of the 6 mahogany desks in the photos (with their chairs): the two cells hold 3 desks with 0.4 m+ clear paths
  • one of the two navy sofas, two of the four glass-door bookcases, the copier (a desktop printer stands in for it)

Differences from the photos. (1) The photographed office is bigger than this cell, so fewer desks. (2) The model has no suspended ceiling: a 600 mm grid with LED panels is built at 2.51 m above the floor, as in the other upper rooms. (3) The wall above the chalkboards is solid in the model; the photos show a glazed clerestory there.
